summary: Use runtime semantics for intersection when set-like protocol access or iteration is dynamically observable.

semantics.get_set_record: observable size/has/keys property access and conversions
semantics.branching: reported size chooses has-scan vs keys-iterator branch
semantics.iterator_close: preserve on abrupt/early completion where specified

tests.name: size getter observable
tests.input: let n=0; const o={get size(){n++;return 0},has(){return false},*keys(){}}; new Set().intersection(o); console.log(n);
